instruction: Align the HTTPS client requirements (PLT-099, PLT-100 and their tests) with ADR-077 as corrected: a redirect status is returned to the caller as the result and never followed; revocation checking is enabled on every request and a revoked certificate or a revocation check that cannot complete fails the request with "certificate rejected" (fail closed); cookies are disabled; default Windows credentials are never sent (automatic logon high); TLS versions follow the OS default; the session uses the system and per-user proxy settings. Cite ADR-077.
